issue: Top pages have no meta description
evidence: The X100VI review (161,830 impressions in 90 days, 1.2% CTR) and 27 of 35 live posts ship without a meta description, so Google writes its own snippet. Site CTR fell from 1.76% to 1.38% quarter on quarter.
fix: Write a 140–155 character description for every post, leading with the searcher's question (e.g. "Real X100VI sample photos, settings and film recipes after 18 months of use").

evidence: About 90% of organic sessions land on blog posts, but every one of the 73 key events in the period started on a service page, the homepage or /contact. Blog landings recorded 0 key events.
fix: Add a contextual call to action to each review (author box with "Book a Canberra shoot", preset upsell on X100VI and Lightroom posts) and track preset clicks as a key event.

issue: Service pages are thin and have no H1
evidence: About 30 service and portfolio pages (wedding, events, headshots, automotive, branding, real estate and more) have no H1, and the core service pages carry only 250–320 words. Queries like "brand photographer" (pos 7.1) and "event photographer" (pos 17.8) stall on these pages.
fix: Give each service page one keyword H1, 600–900 words (process, pricing guide, FAQs, local proof), client logos and a Service schema block.

issue: Brand and studio queries split across pages
evidence: 25 queries rank with two or three URLs. "brand photographer near me" splits between / and /branding-product; "photo studio canberra" (840 impressions) lands on a blog listicle instead of a service page.
fix: Point one URL at each intent: link the listicle to a new Studio hire page, de-optimise the homepage for "brand photography" and strengthen /branding-product.

evidence: /blog/why-i-started-using-photography-shot-lists and /blog/why-i-stopped-editing-every-photo are in sitemap.xml but return 404.
fix: Republish or unpublish both posts so Squarespace drops them from the sitemap; 301 to the closest live post if they were ever linked.

evidence: /blog/tag/* pages (246–405 words of excerpts) are in the sitemap and indexable, diluting crawl budget and creating near-duplicates.
fix: Set tag pages to noindex in Squarespace SEO settings, or stop tagging posts.

evidence: /real-estate-airbnb-photography and /real-estate-trade-1 share an identical title and description; five "free website audit" city pages are near-identical (413 words each).
fix: Merge the two real-estate pages with a 301; consolidate the city audit pages into one page with location sections.

evidence: Squarespace's AI-crawler setting blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended and others. AI-assistant sessions already grew from 7 to 43 quarter on quarter.
fix: Decide deliberately: allow at least OAI-SearchBot / PerplexityBot / Claude-SearchBot so reviews can be cited in AI answers, while keeping training bots blocked if preferred.

evidence: Homepage CLS 0.247 (needs-improvement band starts at 0.1), 5.7 MB transferred and 152 requests on desktop.
fix: Set width/height on gallery images, lazy-load below-the-fold galleries, and serve smaller hero images.

issue: Slow server response on the top page
evidence: X100VI review: 1.34 s time to first byte and 3.2 s LCP on a desktop connection, 2.4 MB and 17 third-party hosts.
fix: Remove unused embeds and scripts, lazy-load sample-photo galleries, cap images at 2000 px wide.

evidence: 17 of 35 posts have titles over 70 characters, most of it the " — Darma Photography" suffix.
fix: Shorten the site-wide title suffix to " | Darma" and front-load the keyword.

evidence: /blog has 20 H1s, /lightroom-presets 10 and /travel-blog 5; /travel-blog is titled "Blog 3".
fix: Use H2 for post cards; rename /travel-blog to "Travel Blog — Darma Photography".

evidence: /prints has 22 images without alt text; product pages 16–24 each.
fix: Add descriptive alt text (location, subject, framing).

evidence: Direct sessions spiked on 18 Aug 2026 (180), 3 Jan 2026 (155) and 1 Feb 2026 (138) against a daily mean of 18, mostly desktop.
fix: Add a GA4 data filter or segment excluding the offending hostnames/IPs so sessions reflect real visitors.

issue: Squarespace staging domain is linking to live pages
evidence: URL Inspection lists marlin-rust-dc32.squarespace.com as a referring URL for /branding-product.
fix: Set nathandarma.com as the primary domain so the built-in squarespace.com address redirects, and check it is not indexed (site:marlin-rust-dc32.squarespace.com).

evidence: http://www.nathandarma.com/ logged 2,348 impressions this period alongside the https version.
fix: Confirm "Secure (HTTPS)" and HSTS are on in Squarespace; Google should consolidate within weeks.

issue: Canonical tags point to redirecting .html URLs
evidence: 30 wiki pages plus /blog, 6 category pages and /roadmap declare canonicals like /wiki/basics/activation.html, which 301s back to the page. URL Inspection shows Google overriding the tag (it indexed /wiki/basics/activation and /wiki/workflow/tethering under the clean URL), but /wiki/culling/ai-scoring is still "URL is unknown to Google". Conflicting signals slow discovery and waste crawl.
fix: Fix the canonical generator to emit the clean URL (no .html) and set build.format so links, canonicals and sitemap agree.

issue: Sitemap not listed on this Search Console property
evidence: sitemap-index.xml (112 URLs) is in robots.txt, but the API lists no sitemap for the https://get-fovea.app/ property (URL Inspection still reports pages as "Submitted", so it may be submitted elsewhere). Confirm it appears under Sitemaps.
fix: Submit https://get-fovea.app/sitemap-index.xml in Search Console and remove noindex tag pages from it.

issue: Three pages compete for each competitor term
evidence: Aftershoot: /aftershoot-vs-fovea, /compare/aftershoot (identical title) and /best-aftershoot-alternative-2026. Narrative Select and Photo Mechanic have the same pattern. "narrative select alternative" splits across two URLs at position 14.
fix: Keep one "X alternative" page and one "X vs Fovea" page per competitor; 301 /compare/* into the vs pages and differentiate titles.

evidence: Homepage transfers 7.4 MB, 7.1 MB of it images (22 requests).
fix: Convert screenshots to AVIF/WebP at display size and lazy-load below the fold. Target < 1.5 MB.

evidence: Search Console shows impressions on both /best-photo-culling-software-wedding-photographers and the /…/ version (200 impressions each); internal links still use the slash form.
fix: Update internal links to the canonical no-slash form; the 301s already exist.

evidence: 13 BlogPosting pages render two H1 elements (layout title + article title).
fix: Demote the layout title to a div or H2.

evidence: The homepage's 118-character description is reused on 12 indexable pages (blog, 6 categories, contact, privacy, terms, refund, auth) and 38 noindex tag pages.
fix: Write unique descriptions for indexable pages; leave noindex pages as-is.

issue: noindex tag pages listed in the sitemap
evidence: 38 /tag/* pages are noindex,follow but included in the sitemap, sending mixed signals.
fix: Exclude noindex routes from the sitemap integration filter.

evidence: /auth/auth-code-error is index,follow and listed in the sitemap.
fix: Add noindex and remove from sitemap.

evidence: GA4 logged 24 purchase events since February but only A$235 of revenue (all in March).
fix: Send value and currency with every purchase event (or log trials as a separate key event).

evidence: 73% of sessions are Direct, and the site-wide engagement rate is 27.6%, which hides which launches and communities drive sign-ups.
fix: UTM-tag every link in newsletters, Reddit/forum posts and partner pages; filter internal traffic.

issue: Pricing page has no Offer markup
evidence: Homepage has SoftwareApplication schema, but /pricing has none and there is no Organization or FAQ markup.
fix: Add SoftwareApplication offers (price, currency) to /pricing and Organization with sameAs to the homepage.

evidence: Contact, Partnerships, Roadmap and the auth page repeat the brand suffix.
fix: Remove the brand from the page-level title where the template appends it.

issue: Site is not known to Google
evidence: URL Inspection on the homepage returns "URL is unknown to Google"; the Search Console property has zero impressions.
fix: Submit the sitemap, request indexing for all 8 pages, and earn a first few links (Region/RiotACT wedding lists, Easy Weddings profile, Google Business Profile).

evidence: /sitemap.xml returns 404 and robots.txt has no Sitemap line.
fix: Generate sitemap.xml at build time and reference it in robots.txt.

issue: Analytics property created today with no goals
evidence: GA4 property was created on 10 Oct 2026; realtime shows hits arriving, but no key events are configured.
fix: Mark the enquiry form submission (generate_lead) and email/phone clicks as key events.

evidence: Gallery has 113 words, Events 268 and Enquire 251. Competing planners rank with venue guides, real-wedding stories and FAQs.
fix: Expand weddings and events pages to 800+ words with process, pricing ranges, venues served and FAQs; add real-wedding case studies.

evidence: Local wedding and event searches are dominated by map packs and directories (Easy Weddings, Oneflare, Wezoree).
fix: Create and verify a Google Business Profile in the "Wedding planner" category; ask early clients for reviews.

evidence: LocalBusiness markup is present on every page (good). No Service, FAQPage or Review markup yet.
fix: Add Service entries for wedding planning, event planning and photography, plus FAQPage on /packages.

evidence: The WordPress → Squarespace move dropped all 19 legacy service URLs without redirects. They still hold 97% of Forte's impressions (Google last crawled them on 30 Aug and still lists them as indexed).
fix: Add 301s in Squarespace URL Mappings from each legacy URL to the closest new page today; rebuild the missing service pages and point the redirects at them.

issue: New site has no service pages
evidence: The new site has 8 pages (home, about, contact, projects). There is nothing to rank for "custom home builders canberra", "home renovations canberra", "kitchen renovations canberra" or "house extensions canberra" — the topics that earned impressions before.
fix: Rebuild: Custom homes, Luxury homes, Renovations, Kitchens & bathrooms, Extensions, Knockdown rebuild, each 800–1,200 words with projects and FAQs.

issue: Key new pages not indexed yet
evidence: URL Inspection: /about and /contact are "Discovered – currently not indexed"; only the homepage, /our-projects and project pages are indexed.
fix: Request indexing for /about and /contact, link them from the homepage body (not only the nav), and add unique copy and descriptions.

issue: Search Console sitemap is out of date
evidence: The submitted sitemap dates from Dec 2022; the old Yoast sitemap_index.xml now 404s. Squarespace sitemap lists 8 pages, 0 indexed.
fix: Resubmit https://www.fortebuildinggroup.com.au/sitemap.xml and request indexing for the new pages.

issue: Staging domain is referring to the live site
evidence: URL Inspection lists cheetah-ocelot-kyw4.squarespace.com as a referring URL for the homepage.
fix: Confirm the built-in squarespace.com domain redirects to the primary domain (Settings → Domains → primary) and is not indexed.

issue: No analytics for the client site
evidence: No GA4 property for Forte is available to this account, so leads and organic sessions cannot be measured.
fix: Create a GA4 property (or get access), add it via Squarespace Code Injection, and set enquiry submissions as a key event.

issue: No meta descriptions; homepage title is just the brand
evidence: All 8 pages lack a meta description. Homepage title "Forte Building Group" (20 chars) has no service or location keyword. Homepage carries 11 H1s; project pages have none.
fix: Title: "Luxury Custom Home Builder Canberra | Forte Building Group"; one H1 per page; unique descriptions.

evidence: No HomeAndConstructionBusiness / LocalBusiness markup with address, licence number, service area or reviews.
fix: Add HomeAndConstructionBusiness JSON-LD via Code Injection, including areaServed (ACT, Queanbeyan) and builder licence.

evidence: Squarespace's AI-crawler toggle blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended and others.
fix: Allow AI search crawlers so the business can be cited in AI answers about Canberra builders.

evidence: Homepage: 7 of 9 images have no alt text; project pages have 1 each.
fix: Describe each image (suburb, room, finish).

evidence: Homepage HTML is 1.3 MB with 88 requests; 0.9 s TTFB on desktop.
fix: Remove unused sections and embedded fonts; compress hero media.
